figures.name: Baal Hadad

ability.name: Storm Lord Victorious
ability.description: Deal 5 storm damage to all enemies; all nature and earth allies regenerate 2 HP.

figures.description: Champion of the gods who defeated Yam and Mot to become king of heaven, dying and rising with the seasons.

figures.name: El (Canaanite)

ability.name: Divine Assembly
ability.description: Call the council: all enemy special abilities are suspended for 1 turn.

figures.description: Father of all Canaanite gods who presides at the divine assembly and whose wisdom governs all divine decisions.

figures.name: Asherah

ability.name: Sacred Tree
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; grant all goddess allies +2 to all stats.

figures.description: Mother of the seventy gods and Lady of the Sea whose sacred poles stood beside Israelite altars for centuries.

figures.name: Anat (Canaanite)

ability.name: Warrior's Ecstasy
ability.description: Enter blood-frenzy: deal 5 damage to all enemies; gain 1 HP for each enemy struck.

figures.description: Virgin goddess of war who slaughtered armies single-handedly and threatened even El to restore Baal to life.

figures.name: Mot (Canaanite)

ability.name: Gaping Maw
ability.description: Swallow one enemy: reduce all their stats to 1 for 2 turns.

figures.description: God of death whose gaping mouth stretches from earth to heaven, devouring Baal and causing the dry season.

figures.name: Yam (Canaanite)

ability.name: Prince Sea
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all enemies; 50% chance to push any one enemy off the field for 1 turn.

figures.description: Prince of the sea and rivers who challenged the divine assembly's authority and demanded Baal as his slave.

figures.name: Kothar-wa-Khasis (Canaanite)

ability.name: Yagrush and Aymur
ability.description: Forge two magical clubs for Baal: grant one ally two attacks next turn.

figures.description: The divine craftsman who forged the magical clubs Yagrush (Driver) and Aymur (Chaser) for Baal's victory.

figures.name: Dagon

ability.name: Harvest Lord
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; all earth and grain abilities gain +2 power.

figures.description: God of grain and father of Baal who was also adopted as the supreme deity of the Philistines.

figures.name: Shapsh

ability.name: Torch of Heaven
ability.description: Reveal all hidden cards; deal 3 fire damage to all dark-aligned enemies.

figures.description: Sun goddess and torch-bearer of the gods who mediates between the divine and underworld realms.

figures.name: Astarte (Canaanite)

ability.name: Evening Star
ability.description: Grant +3 power to one warrior ally; charm one non-warrior enemy.

figures.description: The Canaanite form of the universal Near Eastern love-and-war goddess who received horse sacrifices.

figures.name: Litan

ability.name: Twisting Serpent
ability.description: Coil around one enemy: they lose all buffs and cannot use abilities for 2 turns.

figures.description: The primordial Leviathan of Canaanite myth whose battle with Baal echoes in the Hebrew Bible.

figures.name: Athirat

ability.name: She Who Walks the Sea
ability.description: Move any ally to any position; grant +2 magic to all water allies.

figures.description: Another form of Asherah, Lady of the Sea, who walks upon the divine ocean and intercedes for humanity.

figures.name: Yarikh

ability.name: Lamp of Heaven
ability.description: All allies gain +1 speed; remove all darkness debuffs from the field.

figures.description: Moon god the wanderer whose silver light illuminates the night and whose dew waters the fields.

figures.name: Nikkal

ability.name: Orchard Blessing
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies; all nature and earth allies gain +1 power.

figures.description: Moon goddess married to Yarikh whose name means Great Lady and who governs all fruit-bearing trees.

figures.name: Pidray

ability.name: Morning Mist
ability.description: All allies' stats are hidden from enemy view for 1 turn.

figures.description: Baal's daughter Pidray of the mist, one of the three divine maidens who dwell in Baal's palace.

figures.name: Tallay

ability.name: Dew Drop
ability.description: Restore 1 HP to all allies at the start of each turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: Baal's daughter Tallay of the dew whose gentle moisture brings life to the parched Canaanite earth.

figures.name: Arsay

ability.name: Earth's Depth
ability.description: Reduce all enemies' defense by 1 for 1 turn from earthen power.

figures.description: Baal's third daughter Arsay of the earth who rules over the dark places beneath the ground.

figures.name: Athtar

ability.name: Failed King
ability.description: When placed on the throne: deal 3 damage to one enemy but immediately lose 2 power from inadequacy.

figures.description: The morning star deity who attempted to take Baal's throne, found it too large and descended to rule below.

figures.name: Gapn and Ugar

ability.name: Divine Messenger
ability.description: Deliver a message: grant one ally +2 to their most important stat this battle.

figures.description: The two divine messengers (Vine and Field) who carry Baal's commands across heaven and earth.

figures.name: Rapi'uma

ability.name: Heroes of Old
ability.description: When any ally falls, they grant +1 to all remaining allies' stats from heroic legacy.

figures.description: The deified shades of ancient heroes whom Baal feasts and who aid in healing and protection.
